scope: Proxy scale: 150M trainable parameters, 45-minute active training, Pile slice; NOT TinyStories and NOT the terminal 1.3B comparison. First apples-to-apples GDN2-vs-emender LM length receipt only when all arms complete.
methodology: X40 context_probe: two reset batch-1 contiguous windows per length, starts i*T on the same held-out prefix; all next-token positions scored. Token coverage differs by length. No recurrent state carried between windows.
